customManagers.description: secret-scan's trufflehog-version default selects the trufflehog image; no built-in manager reads it, and CI fails unless it equals the trufflehog Action's version.

packageRules.description: The trufflehog Action and its image default move in one pull request (CI's parity check fails a split). Comes after the preset's rules, so it wins over its github-actions group.
